plain: A researcher named Mike Masters, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of Antonio Villas Boas, a man in Brazil who in 1957 says he had physical intercourse with a woman aboard a craft. According to Masters, Villas Boas described her as a woman who looked slightly different from women he knew, with higher cheekbones and a pointier chin. Masters raises it because, if true, it would suggest the visitors are close enough to humans to be related to us.
